skills.name: excalidraw-layout-rules
skills.description: Layout rules for creating clean, readable Excalidraw diagrams programmatically via evaluate_expression. Prevents common mistakes: overlapping arrows, cramped text, unreadable labels.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.description: Identifies and removes signs of AI-generated writing from text. Detects inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary, passive voice, negative parallelisms, filler phrases, and more. Makes text sound natural and human-written.

skills.name: ingest-deep
skills.description: Deep ingest of one source in a Karpathy-style multi-turn dialog. Handles PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, Markdown, web clips and YouTube videos, including videos whose transcript is not in the page. Triage first, then the user picks topics and output mode, then block-level links point every claim back into the source. Use for "ingest deep", "deep dive a source", "sense-making note", "Zettel aus dieser Quelle", "tiefer Ingest", "YouTube-Video ingesten", "Transkript in den Vault". Not for quick inbox capture and not for meeting recordings.

skills.name: knowledge-batch-ingest
skills.description: Integrate an entire folder of notes and documents at once. Groups files thematically, presents proposals per group, and processes after user confirmation. Uses entity cache across files for token efficiency.

skills.name: knowledge-ingest
skills.description: Integrate new notes into the knowledge graph. Create PDFs as markdown source notes. Set properties, links, MOC entries. Prefer existing entities, propose new ones as stub notes.

skills.name: knowledge-rename
skills.description: Batch-rename attachments (PDFs, images) by convention. Author-Year_Title for sources, context-based for images.

skills.name: meeting-summary
skills.description: Compact summary of a transcript note that stays digestible in under a minute. Strictly on the transcript, no interpretations. Sets block-IDs at key passages and links each statement in the summary discreetly via ↗ symbol to the source passage. Single-note layout (summary on top, transcript below).

skills.name: note-creator
skills.description: Creates new Obsidian notes with content that is always humanized and directly citable (zitierfähig). Triggered whenever the user asks to create, write, or draft a note, document, summary, or any vault content. Enforces the humanizer skill on all generated text before writing to the vault. Handles German umlauts (ö ä ü) correctly. Avoids em dashes and en dashes. Produces natural, human-sounding prose.

skills.name: office-workflow
skills.description: Professional workflow for creating Office documents (PPTX, DOCX, XLSX) with structured process, design principles, and quality standards

skills.name: presentation-design
skills.description: Universal presentation design principles -- content classification, storytelling frameworks, visual vocabulary. Applies to ALL presentations.

skills.name: weekly-meeting-summary
skills.description: Condenses every meeting note of the current week into one compact weekly digest. Writes a new note with key statements, decisions, open points and next steps, ordered by meeting. Trigger phrases: weekly summary, Wochenzusammenfassung Meetings, summarise my meetings, fasse meine Meetings zusammen, weekly meeting digest, Meetings der Woche zusammenfassen, was war diese Woche in meinen Meetings.
